objective: Evaluate a fixed zero-dimensional ignited enclosure pressure-peaking model against public large-scale hydrogen experiments not previously opened for outcome analysis.

source.title: Large scale experiments and model validation of Pressure Peaking Phenomena-ignited hydrogen releases

apparatus.ignition: immediate ignition at the vertical release

cohort.development_only_reason: Case 1 was opened during the earlier inventory sample check, and cases 29-31 were opened during the earlier channel-integrity replay. All four are excluded from confirmatory scoring.
cohort.exclusion_rule: Exclude only a file that fails the Dataverse byte count or MD5 identity check, lacks SIGMA/GEN3i channels, has a non-monotonic time base, or has no finite positive mass-flow and overpressure samples. Report every exclusion; do not replace excluded cases.

fixed_model.type: zero-dimensional perfectly mixed reacting enclosure with ideal-gas species and lumped wall heat transfer
fixed_model.hydrogen_input: measured non-negative SIGMA mass-flow time series
fixed_model.pressure_observation: baseline-corrected GEN3i overpressure; deterministic pre-ignition median baseline only
fixed_model.parameter_policy: The source-reported common coefficients are fixed across all cases. No per-case fitting, outcome-dependent coefficient selection, or holdout retuning is permitted.

signal_processing.initial_temperature: Mean of the four per-channel medians over SIGMA time 0.2 to 1.2 s, converted from degC to K.
signal_processing.pressure_baseline: Median GEN3i overpressure over time 0.2 to 1.2 s, subtracted once from the full pressure trace.
signal_processing.mass_flow: Negative values are clipped to zero. The 10 kHz input is reduced to 500 Hz by non-overlapping 20-sample arithmetic means before interpolation; no smoothing or outcome-dependent filtering is allowed.
signal_processing.peak_definition: Largest baseline-corrected measured or simulated gauge overpressure in the frozen peak window.
signal_processing.time_origin: The source SIGMA and GEN3i clocks are used without outcome-dependent shifting.

primary.name: peak_overpressure_absolute_error_kpa
primary.basis: The associated publication reports prediction within approximately plus or minus 2 kPa.

decision_rule.confirmatory_success: At least 20 eligible holdout cases and at least 80% of eligible cases with peak-overpressure absolute error no greater than 2.0 kPa.
decision_rule.failure_interpretation: Retain and report the negative result. Any later model revision requires a new protocol and a new untouched dataset or explicitly exploratory status.

claim_boundary: This protocol concerns only ignited pressure peaking in a vented enclosure. It cannot validate an outdoor H70 station fueling loop, jet-flame radiation distance, emergency controls, operator response, or SAGA effectiveness.
